_comment: Issue #263 predeclared coverage matrix, committed BEFORE any PVT/mismatch run.
Git history is the proof of ordering: this file's first commit precedes every record under
layout/folded-res-qual/pvt-reports/. Do not edit it to fit a result; a changed matrix is a
new file/version with its own commit and its own record.
Scope: isolated passive devices only (model-only chains of the PDK resistor subcircuit,
plus the measured li1 joint resistance from record 20261010-033502-704005c). No full-LDO
simulation, no layout redraw, no length compensation, no schematic change, no full-core
compliance claim.
Equivalence criterion (UNCHANGED from #253's README, 'Equivalence tolerance'): a fold is
EQUIVALENT only if |R_chain/R_unsplit - 1| <= 3 x sigma_local(unsplit), sigma_local =
sw_mm_<model>*mismatch_factor/sqrt(W*L) read from the PDK library at run time
(R_BIAS 0.2462 %, R_FB 1.6010 %). It is applied to the WORST shift over every deterministic
corner x temperature x operating-voltage point below, each shift taken against the unsplit
device at the SAME point. Infeasible folds are reported, not rescued by relaxing it.
Mismatch gates (new for #263, fixed here before any run; the model draws every body and
head term independently per instance with AGAUSS, i.e. zero correlation between segments):
M1  |mean_chain - mean_unsplit| / mean_unsplit <= the same tolerance, at every MC point
(mean shift under mismatch must agree with the deterministic claim).
M2  sigma_chain / sigma_unsplit <= 1.10 at every MC point (N independent head terms must
not inflate the local-mismatch spread by more than 10 %).
A candidate N is QUALIFIED only if the deterministic criterion, M1 and M2 all hold. The
recommendation per resistor is the largest qualified N among the candidates; if only N=1
qualifies the verdict is 'no qualified fold'. The nonequivalent control (N=16 for R_BIAS)
must FAIL the deterministic criterion or the study is invalid (flow failure).
Operating voltages (current schematic intent, design/README.md and spec/target-spec.md):
R_BIAS: ~1-2 uA across ~1.2 Mohm gives 1.2-2.4 V; VIN 2.97-3.63 V moves it; points 1.2, 2.0, 2.4 V.
R_FB_A/B/C: VOUT 1.8 V +-2 % across three equal units = 0.588, 0.6, 0.612 V per unit.
R_CZ (res_xhigh_po L=52) is out of scope: no fold is needed at ~100 um bank width.

tool_pins.joint_source_record: layout/folded-res-qual/reports/20261010-033502-704005c (klt pin 040f3406, joint 37.7905 ohm, unchanged; no geometry regenerated)

limitations_declared_up_front: Joint resistance is the 27 C tt value of the pinned-geometry li1 strap, held constant over temperature (li1 tempco not modelled); a 4x sensitivity bounds a larger strap pitch.
Mismatch draws are independent per segment and per head (model behaviour); real spatial correlation between adjacent segments is not modelled.
sf/fs and *_mm skew sections of the PDK leave the resistor parameters nominal; resistor skew comes from ll/hh.
Passive-device evidence only: says nothing about the LDO meeting any spec row.
